info.title: ROASWELL access specification
info.description: Planned R1 access contracts only. These routes are not implemented or registered in the live API.

get.description: Read the organization selected by verified server-side access context.
List memberships in the verified organization; role checks are enforced by the future service.

post.description: Grant a customer role to a recipient user. This cannot grant founder access.

get.description: List approval records allowed by the verified actor and customer visibility policy.

post.description: Request publication or customer review of one exact version. The server assigns requester and state.
A permitted human approves or rejects the exact requested version; the service checks role, expiry and current version.
